_comment: Real AUTO-role-detection prototype config for the final ESP32-H2 SuperMini graduation-project hardware (see docs/pogo-interface.md 'confirmed GPIO profile' and README's wiring section). This board's permanently-paired sensor is a Sensirion SHT45 (temperature + humidity). dev_mode=AUTO: ROOT/INTERMEDIATE/LEAF is derived at runtime from real BASE_ID + DETECT_IN/OUT + PEER_HELLO, never forced. Both prototype configs (this file and prototype_bh1750.json) share the EXACT SAME upstream_port/downstream_port block -- the only per-board differences are driver_id, i2c_address, sensor_type_bitmap and calibration, exactly as section 2 of the follow-up spec requires.
_driver_comment: SENSOR_DRIVER_ID_SHT45 (see components/sensor_provider/include/sensor_provider/sensor_provider.h) and the TEMPERATURE/HUMIDITY channel bits (see components/sensor_channel/include/sensor_channel/sensor_channel.h) are resolved by name here -- tools/pack_module_config.py's DRIVER_IDS/CHANNEL_BITS tables mirror those two C headers bit-for-bit, so this file never repeats a magic number by hand.
_timeout_comment: SHT45 high-precision measurement takes ~8.2ms max per the datasheet; 200ms leaves generous margin for I2C bus contention/retries without stalling child_service's SENSOR_HELLO handler for long.
_upstream_comment: UART0. Deep-sleep-ready GPIO profile (this follow-up): UPSTREAM DETECT_IN is GPIO12 and DETECT_OUT is GPIO2 -- swapped from the earlier profile (DETECT_IN=2/DETECT_OUT=12) because GPIO12 is an ESP32-H2 RTC GPIO channel (see components/module_config/deep_sleep_gpio.h) usable as a future terminal-leaf Deep-sleep ext1 wake source, while GPIO2 is not. GPIO2 is NOT GPIO13 (documented onboard LED pin, see docs/pogo-interface.md) and NOT GPIO6 (GPIO6/7 are not bonded out on the ESP32-H2 SuperMini/SiP package at all); see docs/pogo-interface.md's 'Confirmed GPIO profile' section for the full history/evidence. IMPORTANT: the real boards are still wired to the OLD profile (DETECT_IN=2/DETECT_OUT=12) -- swap the two DETECT wires before flashing firmware built from this config, see README.md.
_downstream_comment: UART1, matches the previous dev-board UART1 pin choice (GPIO10/11) plus real DETECT_IN/OUT. base_id_gpio is always -1 on DOWNSTREAM -- BASE_ID is only ever read on UPSTREAM (see docs/pogo-interface.md).
